text: Write a program that shows a string's length in characters, in UTF-8 bytes, and in UTF-16 bytes. Fill in the three blanks.
explanation: Verified: hello is 5/5/10, café is 4/5/8, naïve is 5/6/10. Three different numbers for the same text, and none of them is *the* length. ASCII text costs one byte per character in UTF-8 and two in UTF-16; accented text costs more in UTF-8 and the same in UTF-16. Which encoding is smaller depends on the language being written, which is why the argument between them was never settled on technical grounds alone.
